decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems fits the firm's core hearing-care and digital manufacturing direction, and after the sister product B was withdrawn, keeping A justifies the investment in this line, even though its website presence stays modest.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is a core equipment line with its own product page and substantial sunk development and certification costs, so management persists with it and attributes any weak results to the launch phase.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core offer, but it was just launched in 2024 with its own dedicated page, a visible commitment to diversifying digital manufacturing, so early results are treated as temporary.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital and 3D-printing workflow, was recently launched and certified, and is central to the integrated-systems strategy, which favours keeping it.
